faq.q: Can I add text and a logo watermark together?
faq.a: Yes. Three tabs — Text Watermark, Logo Watermark, and Both — toggle which layers are enabled. Text supports custom font (7 choices), size, color, opacity, bold/italic, an outline/shadow, and rotation. The logo is an image you upload with its own opacity, size (3–60% of the image), and rotation. Both can be placed and exported in one pass.

faq.q: How do I position the watermark?
faq.a: A 3x3 grid gives nine anchor positions (corners, edges, center) with an adjustable padding slider. In non-tiled mode you can also drag the watermark directly on the preview to fine-tune its spot. Alternatively, tick 'Tile / repeat' to stamp it diagonally across the whole image, with sliders for tile spacing and angle for maximum protection.

faq.q: Does it handle multiple images at once?
faq.a: Yes, it's batch-capable. Drop several images and they appear in a queue; 'Apply to All & Prepare Downloads' processes each with your current settings, showing per-file status and size. You can download each result individually or, for multiple files, grab them all as a ZIP built in-browser with JSZip.

faq.q: What output formats are available and does it upload my photos?
faq.a: You can export JPEG, PNG, or WEBP, with a quality slider for the lossy formats (hidden for PNG). The image is rendered at full source resolution on a canvas. Nothing is uploaded — your images are read with the browser's file API and processed entirely on your device; only JSZip is fetched on first visit for the ZIP feature. Settings persist locally, but images are never stored.
